purpose: Ex-ante architecture design for the next alpha-side research phase after Q036 isolated risk-overlay effects; define orthogonal alpha mechanisms and a fresh validation protocol without executing performance selection.

candidate_families.name: multi-horizon trend continuation
candidate_families.orthogonality: directional persistence; distinct from short-horizon reversal and risk overlays

candidate_families.name: cross-sectional momentum
candidate_families.orthogonality: relative-strength ranking across assets; signal selection rather than exposure control

candidate_families.name: residual/relative-value signal
candidate_families.orthogonality: idiosyncratic return component after explicit common-mode or market-factor removal

candidate_families.name: point-in-time event/information signal
candidate_families.orthogonality: timestamped external information with strict publication-time alignment

candidate_families.name: carry/income or defensive-premium signal
candidate_families.orthogonality: compensation from carry/income/defensive premia rather than directional trend
